title: THE WHAT IS NEW CARD NAMES THE NEW BELT
why: The card was stamped v25.81 and the stamp may not trail the build by more than 0.15. The card was stamped v25.81 and every ship stops when it falls 0.16 behind. Its new line names the builds since: the belt redo (his order 2026-10-13: guns 1-4, throwables 5-6, medical 7-8, armour 9, the weakest gun swaps out) and the DEMO fixes (extraction and siege the same as CAREER, his rule).
now: The what is new card names the new belt.

edits.anchor: 'THIS IS AN ALPHA. Things will break. When something does, the game writes it into your run report and tells you so; that report is how it gets fixed.',
